title: Observe filter pushdown
brief: Check whether a filter reaches a scan instead of assuming it does.
instructions: Return paid order IDs in the exact UTC interval [2024-01-01, 2025-01-01).
A paid order is an order whose own status is 'paid'; the payments table carries a separate status that these challenges never ask about.
Express the same filter through a named relation in the secondary query.
Report reported when a scan contains Filters text, or not-reported when it does not.
Neither optimizer shape is required for completion.
starterSql: SELECT order_id, ordered_at, status FROM orders LIMIT 10;
starterExplanation: The starter shows unfiltered activity. Write both filtered forms before measuring whether the engine reports scan Filters.

hints.text: Use a filter for the exact UTC reporting interval.
Name the filtered population in the secondary query, then read that relation.
The upper timestamp is excluded. A correct query can report either presence or absence of scan filter text.

assessment.secondaryStarterSql: WITH reporting_orders AS (SELECT order_id, status FROM orders) SELECT * FROM reporting_orders LIMIT 10;
